official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description: Generate a five- to 47-second music cue from a scene, mood and instrumentation brief. Listen and download the audio inline. Instrumental output is requested, but musical details and duration may vary. This does not copy artists, clone voices, synchronize music to video or guarantee exclusivity or licensing rights. A connected Firemoon account is required.

limitations_ja: 5〜47秒、曲の内容や長さは変わる場合がある。Firemoonアカウントが必要。動画同期や権利・独占性の保証はしない。
